Date: 2026-10-10. Implementation is complete. Local deterministic, private-store,
resource, actual Minecraft cold/restart and offline CLI gates passed. Pinned
Gradle and genuine-model CI results are recorded in the final CI addendum before
merge; a controlled missing-reference fixture is distinct from real-model evidence.

Source baseline: `b5ccd06b9c6a6dd8cfde6f344fc34e1a953f2d3d`.
Documentation specification SHA:
`c7d56e5bb029eb4ef10c1ceaed0e9bfdfae96584`.
[Canonical specification](https://github.com/senavirathne/CognitiveCraft-Documentation/blob/c7d56e5bb029eb4ef10c1ceaed0e9bfdfae96584/docs/source/docs/implementation-prompts.md#imp-014-1).
Architecture extension **0.5** remains unchanged. The new diagnostic record and
complete-catalog fingerprint schemas are **1**. Existing IR, artifacts/admission,
repository, jobs, citizen identity, leases, outcomes and broker schemas remain
unchanged. [Exported interfaces, policy, storage and operator contract](IMP-014.1-contracts.md).

## Result and compatibility

The compiler preserves `UNKNOWN_PRIMITIVE` at `$.body[0].id` for the valid
synthetic `cognitivecraft:smelt_item@1` reference. Before this change, that failure
entered the generic bounded repair branch when repair was available (baseline
source inspection). After the change it carries compiler-owned typed absence
proof and immediately ends `NOT_ADMITTED / UNSUPPORTED_PRIMITIVE`: one initial
authorized inference, zero repair/fixture/trial/publication/effects even with a
positive repair allowance. Malformed local syntax, known-pair mismatches and
dependency errors retain their distinct failures and normal repair policy.

Full IR body lists from the local adapter reach compiler validation. Existing
compact known-body lowering is preserved; unknown compact names remain malformed.
Safe protocol metadata is transport-neutral. No new primitive, capability,
backend, scheduler, learning loop, planner input or gameplay authority was added.

Supplied `evaluateCandidate` inputs reject without AI demand. A complete runtime
catalog of all eleven signatures shares lookup and fingerprint identity; the six
generation prompt signatures never establish absence. Unavailable/incomplete
catalog metadata suppresses persistence while preserving unsupported rejection.

Collection defaults OFF. Metadata and explicitly scoped redacted excerpts are
trusted startup choices. One independent bounded daemon owns disposable private
diagnostic storage. No player command, packet, autocomplete or HTTP inspection
route exists. The report is an explicitly invoked host-only advisory export.

API **0.161.0+26.3** and GameTest API **4.0.32+3434d6d95d** use the repository's

No dependency pin or authority guard was relaxed to make local checks pass.

The 15.5 MiB figure is a checked reservation proof excluding fixed JVM/class
overhead, not total RSS. Actual segment/report tests include salt, lock, unknown
file and temporary-file footprint. Directory file cap 16/17, lower capacity,
exact fits, N+1 write/scan rejection and all 24 configuration ceilings execute.
Replay and normal maintenance do not spend both inspection budgets in one cycle.

In the blocked writer GameTest an authorized gap uses a separate empty owner store,
because admitted methods are correctly shared within the known world scope.
Both controller compositions share one diagnostic daemon/sink. The known admission
has one explicit setup fake call. The gap has one initial call/no repair; two later
known jobs perform physical delivery while the diagnostic latch remains closed,
including owner reload with inference and diagnostics off. Shutdown finishes
while the latch remains closed. The separate JVM starts from saved wheat=6,
delivers one more wheat using saved knowledge, and makes zero model calls.
Diagnostic replay retains occurrences=1 and persistedSnapshots=0; authoritative
hash maps are identical before/after that replay.

## Runtime-discovered defects and final corrections

1. Initial controlled harness parent calls incorrectly widened its trial; a source
   fixture counted one observed cell for a nine-cell area. Existing parent/freshness
   checks rejected both. Fixtures now reserve cumulative parent maxima and exact
   volume. Initial native enrollment similarly placed the mock principal beyond
   the six-block boundary; it now positions the synthetic owner beside its citizen.
   No authority, budget or freshness check was weakened.
2. The first blocked-logger fixture tried generation after a compatible world
   method had already been admitted. Production correctly reused it; the fixture
   then dereferenced absent research status. The fixture now uses an independent
   empty gap store and one shared diagnostic sink alongside the known owner store.
   Failed native crash evidence remains in `build/diagnostics-native-run/`.
3. Cold native run 3 exposed a real startup directory interleaving:
   diagnostic daemon -> store.open -> recursive directory create ->
   authoritative store concurrently created shared world/data parents ->
   exact private-permission verification rejected that shared parent.
   Gameplay continued, but metadata collection disabled and the fixture timed out.
   Production now verifies shared ancestors as owned nonsymlink directories and
   requires 0700 only throughout the diagnostic subtree. Deterministic regression:
   T.concurrentSharedDirectoryCreationDoesNotDisablePrivateDiagnosticSubtree.
   It injects the actual create interleaving and separately proves insecure
   diagnostic ancestors still reject. Fresh cold runs 4 and 5 and warm replay pass.
   The original XML/log remains `diagnostics-native-3.xml/.log`.
4. Review found the last replay slice could be followed by a full normal inspection
   slice. Production now publishes readiness and yields before normal work.
   S.finalReplaySliceDoesNotAlsoSpendNormalMaintenanceBudget proves that boundary.
   The retention fault fixture explicitly checks immediate logical suppression,
   then the following bounded maintenance cycle's physical-delete failure.

No temporary production patches, replacement JAR classes/mixins, weakened expected
outcomes or hidden production workarounds remain.

## Operational limits

Collection is observational and intentionally lossy. Reports always mark the
retained window potentially incomplete and crash/missing-final-snapshot loss
counts unknown. FIFO dedup is recent bounded history, not an unlimited exact set.
Revision saturation seals a row; new-key overload drops observations without
changing research. Future schemas remain inactive and may require an explicit
host diagnostic-only reset. Dynamic catalogs need an atomic complete owner snapshot.

Logical expiry works during idle service and startup/read. Physical deletion
cannot be guaranteed while the process is offline or I/O fails/hangs. A hung
daemon may remain until released/process exit; an already started write can finish
after the shutdown future's 2000 ms deadline. No server thread joins it or spawns
a replacement. POSIX permission enforcement is runtime-verified on Linux; the
ACL fallback fails closed but was not exercised on a Windows host.

Controlled Minecraft fixtures prove runtime classification, private storage,
thread isolation and saved-world execution. Genuine acquisition and actual model
identity/results come from the separately configured existing live workflows;
a stochastic model is not required to invent a missing primitive.
